pgnodemx_data_directory.description: Optional directory to store temporary pgnodemx metric data files. Leave empty to use PostgreSQL’s data directory.

pgnodemx_sample_interval_ms.description: Time in milliseconds between OS metric samples. Minimum 1000 ms recommended.

pgnodemx_cpu_enabled.description: Enable or disable CPU metric collection (e.g., user, system, idle percentages).

pgnodemx_memory_enabled.description: Enable or disable memory metric collection (total, used, free, buffers, cached).

pgnodemx_disk_enabled.description: Enable or disable disk I/O metric collection (read/write throughput and latency).

pgnodemx_network_enabled.description: Enable or disable network metric collection (bytes/packets in/out, errors).

pgnodemx_network_interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to monitor. Leave empty to monitor all non-loopback interfaces.

pgnodemx_max_file_descriptors.description: Maximum file descriptors pgnodemx may open (0 = use system default). Set higher if monitoring many disks or mounts.

pgnodemx_log_level.description: Log verbosity for pgnodemx internal messages. Use 'debug' only when troubleshooting.
